Subject: Re: CASE-009 source capacity and commercial controls
MIME-Version: 1.0
Content-Type: text/plain; charset=UTF-8

We matched the supplier response to NS-COMP-009, revision R3, and immutable record NS-000009. The standard and priority readiness dates are inputs only; neither is an ERP completion date.

The current catalog covers no more than 14 EA. It excludes original relays already issued or substitute lots outside effectivity, the archived revision R8, PDX demand, and nearby case CASE-010.

Before releasing anything, compare the supplier workbook with current Oracle demand, the released structure, on-hand and reservations, quality holds, finite schedule, and AP-0009. Priority service has capacity held but no exception approval.

If those records conflict, retain the current state and send the conflict back to sourcing and controls. Do not convert a supplier promise, filename, or quoted price into authority.

Regards,
Sourcing control desk
Northstar case CASE-009
